common.noCommands: No command is available to you in the current state.
common.noDecisionAvailable: No decision of the required type is available yet.

decisionIssue.wrong_type: The linked decision is not of the required type.
decisionIssue.recommended: The linked decision is recommended — pending the authorized body; it is not a final approval.
decisionIssue.not_approved: Linked decision status: {status} — only a final approval counts.
decisionIssue.external_approval_missing: The decision is outside the committee delegation and no approval by the authorized body is recorded.
decisionIssue.authority_unassessed: The decision has no authority assessment (within mandate / external authority).

common.noDocuments: No matching document with a stored version.

overview.title: JV & Diligence
overview.subtitle: Partner process, restricted partner rooms, due diligence, negotiations, and separate signing and closing.
overview.parallel: Partner preparation and due diligence can run in parallel with separation: gates G3 / G4 are not prerequisites of the partner process unless an explicit dependency is configured. Every step keeps its own authorization.
overview.noAssumptions: No partner identity, ownership percentage, valuation or term is assumed here: only what authorized people record is shown. Demo partners are fictional and labelled Demo.
overview.stagesHint: Partners per stage (stages are never skipped).
overview.eventsHint: A signing and each closing are separate events with their own checklists and confirmations.

partners.title: Partners
partners.subtitle: Longlist and shortlist with screening criteria, conflicts and engagement stages. There are no default partner names.
partners.ndaNoAccess: An executed NDA does not grant access to any document: materials are reachable only through an explicit, expiring room grant after the Materials access stage, and only items released into the room are visible to the partner.
partners.emptyHint: Partners are added by an authorized person; the platform never suggests or invents partner names.

create.title: Add a partner to the longlist
create.effect: The partner starts at the Identified stage; outreach needs a separate approval.
create.noRealNames: Enter only what is known and authorized — do not enter real names in the demo sandbox.
create.name: Name
create.codeHint: Upper-case letters, digits and hyphens; generated when left empty.

criteria.title: Screening criteria and weights
criteria.hint: Weights must sum to exactly 100. Scores (0–5) are entered as assessments; a weighted score is shown only when every criterion is scored.
criteria.name: Name (English)

edit.title: Screening criteria
edit.effect: Replaces the screening criteria of this project (versioned; recorded in the activity history).
edit.sumRule: The server refuses the set unless the weights sum to exactly 100.

partner.pathHint: Stages cannot be skipped. Contact approval and NDA recording each need their own authorized command.
partner.ownRequest: You requested the pending approval — another authorized person must decide it.
partner.conflictedYou: You have an open conflict disclosure on this partner: you cannot approve its outreach or NDA.
partner.proposalsHint: Proposals received from this partner and the team's assessments, each tagged as a fact (with its source) or a judgement.

outreach.title: Outreach approval
outreach.hint: Separate from the NDA and from materials access.

materials.title: Materials access
materials.hint: The stage allows grants to be issued; it grants nothing by itself.

conflicts.title: Conflict disclosures
conflicts.hint: A person with an open conflict disclosure cannot approve this partner's outreach or NDA.
conflicts.effect: The disclosure is recorded against this partner.

contacts.title: External contacts (counterparty accounts)
contacts.hint: An external account is bound to exactly one counterparty. Binding grants no room access by itself.
contacts.effect: The external account is bound to this counterparty.
contacts.noAccess: Room access still needs an explicit, expiring grant after the Materials access stage.
contacts.revokeEffect: The account is unbound and its grants in this partner's rooms are revoked immediately (history is kept).

outreach.title: Request outreach approval
outreach.effect: An approval request is created; an authorized person (not you, not a conflicted person) decides it within the authority matrix.
outreach.separate: Outreach approval is separate from the NDA and from materials access.

decideOutreach.title: Decide the outreach request
decideOutreach.effectApprove: The partner moves to Approved for contact.
decideOutreach.effectReject: The request is rejected; the partner stays Identified.
decideOutreach.sod: Not the requester and not a person with an open conflict disclosure; within the authority matrix.

submitNda.title: Submit the executed NDA
submitNda.effect: Legal records the NDA as a separate step (not the submitter).

recordNda.title: Record the NDA
recordNda.effect: The partner moves to the NDA stage.
recordNda.effectReject: The submission is rejected; the NDA stays unrecorded.
recordNda.sod: Legal only; not the submitter and not a conflicted person.

advance.title: Advance the engagement stage
advance.hint: Only the next stage is available; skipped stages and approval stages are shown for information only.
advance.none: No stage can be reached with this command.
advance.materialsNoGrant: Materials access issues no grant by itself: grants are given per room, with an expiry.

unshortlist.title: Remove from the shortlist
unshortlist.effect: The partner returns to the longlist (documented reason).

withdraw.title: Withdraw the partner
withdraw.effect: The partner leaves the process; a withdrawn partner cannot re-enter it.
withdraw.grants: Its external room grants are revoked immediately; history is kept.

edit.title: Edit partner details
edit.effect: Changes descriptive fields only (never the stage).

proposals.title: Proposals & assessments
proposals.subtitle: Proposals, scope and terms as received, and the comparative assessment — facts separated from the team's judgement.
proposals.basisNote: Every assessment entry is tagged: a FACT cites its source (document or reference); a JUDGEMENT is the team's view. Unscored criteria are never guessed: the weighted score stays empty until every criterion is scored.
proposals.partnerTitle: Proposals and assessments of one partner
proposals.pickPartner: Choose a partner to see its proposals and assessment entries.
proposals.empty: No proposal recorded for this partner.

fields.title: Title
fields.termsHint: As stated by the partner — nothing is inferred or completed by the platform.

create.title: Record a proposal
create.effect: The proposal is recorded as received, with its source document when available.
create.noInvention: No term, value or scope is invented: leave unknown fields empty.

assessments.title: Assessment entries
assessments.empty: No assessment entry for this partner.

fields.basisHint: Tag every entry: a fact must cite its source; otherwise record it as judgement.
fields.sourceRequired: A fact needs a source reference or a document.

create.title: Add an assessment entry
create.effect: Entries are insert-only; the newest score per criterion counts.
create.basisRule: The server refuses an entry without a basis, and a fact without its source.

scenarios.title: Ownership & governance scenarios
scenarios.subtitle: Versioned ownership, capital-contribution and governance scenarios, shown as proposed.
scenarios.noDefaults: No percentage is defaulted, suggested or derived: a party without an entered percentage stays TBD, and no controlling party is assumed.
scenarios.ownershipHint: List the parties; enter a percentage only when it has been decided or proposed by an authorized person. Leave it empty for TBD.
scenarios.contributionsHint: What each party contributes; an amount only with its currency and unit — otherwise TBD.
scenarios.incomplete: Proposed — not every party has an entered percentage. Nothing here is an approved or assumed split.
scenarios.completeButProposed: Every party has an entered percentage, but the scenario remains a proposal until approved through governance.
scenarios.versionsHint: Versions are immutable: a change creates a new version and the previous ones are preserved.

create.title: New scenario (version 1)
create.effect: Creates version 1 with the parties and the values you entered.

addVersion.title: Add a new version
addVersion.effect: A new immutable version is added; the previous versions are kept.

negotiation.title: Terms & negotiation issues
negotiation.subtitle: Issues with the parties' positions, alternatives, the required approval, its linked decision and the document.
negotiation.approvalRule: An issue that requires approval must link its governance decision; it can be agreed or closed only after that decision's final approval.

fields.requiresApproval: This issue requires a governance approval

create.title: Record a negotiation issue
create.effect: The issue opens with the positions entered.

effect.agree: The parties agree (an issue needing approval needs its final approved decision).
effect.escalate: The issue is escalated for a decision.
effect.close: The issue is closed (reflected in the agreement).

rooms.title: Rooms & VDR
rooms.subtitle: Partner, internal and clean-team rooms: index, grants, disclosures and access history.
rooms.grantsOnly: A room opens only with an explicit, revocable grant (external grants also expire). Room administrators see the metadata of other rooms, never their content.
rooms.noCopyPrevention: The platform cannot prevent screenshots or copies of material once it has been downloaded; the history shows who downloaded what.
rooms.cleanTeamNote: Clean-team rooms are visible only to clean-team members (granted by Legal with an attestation); their material is never disclosed to a counterparty.
rooms.emptyHint: Rooms appear here when you hold a grant, or when you administer rooms.

effect.partner: A partner room belongs to one partner; you receive a manage grant for its index.
effect.internal: An internal room has no partner; you receive a manage grant for its index.
effect.clean_team: A clean-team room: membership is granted by Legal only, with the clean_team role and an attestation (you receive no grant).

room.noGrant: You hold no grant on this room: its content (index, disclosures, DD) is not shown. Administration remains available to room administrators.
room.lockedNotice: Room locked since {at}: every grant and download is suspended. Reason: {reason}
room.lockEffect: Every grant and download is suspended immediately (containment).
room.unlockEffect: Grants that are still valid apply again.
room.editEffect: Changes the room name and description.

index.empty: No document filed in this room.
index.hintPartner: Filing a document in the room does not disclose it: each version is released to the partner separately, by an authorized person other than the requester.
index.hintInternal: Internal room: documents are visible to the room's grantees only; nothing is disclosed to a counterparty.
index.hintCleanTeam: Clean-team room: visible to clean-team members only; its material is never disclosed to a counterparty.

addDocument.title: File a document in this room
addDocument.effect: The document is created in this room and its first version uploaded (scanned before use).
addDocument.notDisclosed: Filing does not disclose it to anyone outside the room's grantees.
addDocument.fileHint: Accepted types and size limits are enforced by the server.

disclosures.requestTitle: Request the release of a document version
disclosures.requestEffect: A release of the current version of "{title}" into the partner room is requested.
disclosures.releaseSeparate: The release itself is approved by an authorized person other than you or the uploader.
disclosures.releaseEffect: The version becomes visible to the counterparty in this room (audited).
disclosures.rejectEffect: The request is rejected; nothing is disclosed.
disclosures.sod: Not the requester and not the uploader of the version.
disclosures.revokeEffect: The item is no longer visible or downloadable in the room; copies already downloaded cannot be recalled.
disclosures.hint: Every request, release, rejection and withdrawal is kept.
disclosures.noPermission: The disclosure history is visible to its authorized readers only.

grants.hint: Grants are the only way into a room. Revocation is effective immediately; the history is kept.
grants.grantEffect: The person can open the room at the chosen level.
grants.externalRule: External accounts: only the partner's bound contact, only after the Materials access stage, read or contribute level, with an expiry of at most {days} days (proposed default — to be confirmed).
grants.cleanTeamRule: Clean-team rooms: Legal grants the clean_team role with the attestation reference.
grants.internalRule: Internal accounts need an active project role; a grant never creates project membership.
grants.sod: You cannot grant access to yourself.
grants.expiresHint: Required for external accounts (at most {days} days).
grants.revokeEffect: Access (including downloads) ends immediately; the grant and its history are kept.
grants.noPermission: Grants are visible to room administrators only.

history.hint: Append-only history of grants, revocations, releases, downloads and locks.
history.subject: Concerning

dd.title: Due diligence
dd.subtitle: DD requests and Q&A with review and release approval, and findings with their implications — scoped to the rooms you are granted.
dd.roomScoped: Requests and findings filed in a room are visible to that room's members only.
dd.releaseRule: Nothing reaches the partner before release: the answer is reviewed by another person, approved for release, then released by an authorized person other than its drafter.
dd.releasedHint: What the counterparty sees: the released answer only — never drafts, reviewers or assignees.
dd.drafterNote: You drafted this answer: another person reviews and releases it.

fields.roomHint: Only rooms where you hold a contribute or manage grant.
fields.question: Question

create.title: Raise a DD request
create.effect: The request is filed in the room and numbered.

assign.title: Assign answer owner and reviewer
assign.effect: Sets the answer owner, the reviewer (a different person) and the due date.
assign.roomWorkers: Both need an active contribute grant on the room.

draft.title: Draft the answer
draft.effect: Saves the draft and its evidence documents (filed in the same room).

submit.title: Submit the answer for review
submit.effect: The reviewer can approve the release, return it to draft or withhold it.

review.title: Review the answer
review.sod: Not the drafter; the designated reviewer when one is set.

effect.approve: The answer is approved for release (it is not released yet).
effect.return: The answer goes back to draft.
effect.withhold: The answer is withheld from the partner.

release.title: Release the answer to the partner room
release.effect: The approved answer becomes visible to the counterparty.

findings.title: DD findings
findings.roomScoped: Findings of a room are visible to its members only. A material finding (high / critical) needs a remediation owner and plan.
findings.materialRule: A material finding (high or critical) requires a remediation owner and a remediation plan.

fields.title: Title
fields.roomHint: A finding in a room is visible to that room's members only.
fields.ownerChange: New remediation owner (leave empty to keep)

create.title: Record a DD finding
create.effect: The finding opens with its materiality and implications.

edit.title: Edit finding
edit.effect: Changes details, materiality and remediation (never the status).

effect.plan_remediation: The remediation owner and plan are recorded.
effect.accept_risk: The risk is accepted with a documented reason.

closing.title: Signing & closing
closing.subtitle: Separate signing and closing events with their own checklists, conditions precedent and authorized confirmations.
closing.separate: Signing and closing are separate events: each closing follows its signing and has its own CP set, checklist, confirmation and status. Signing never closes the transaction.
closing.tasksNeverClose: Completing a task list never closes the transaction: a closing is confirmed only by an authorized person (not the requester) with a final approved decision, after the server re-evaluates every blocking CP.
closing.empty: No signing or closing event recorded.

fields.name: Name
fields.signingHint: A closing follows a signing (its own CP set and confirmation).

signing.title: Create a signing event
signing.effect: The signing has its own checklist and confirmation.

closing.title: Create a closing
closing.effect: The closing follows the chosen signing and has its own CP set, checklist, confirmation and status.

event.readinessHint: Live server evaluation — the same rule the confirmation enforces inside its transaction.
event.readyClosing: No blocker: the signing is confirmed, every blocking CP is verified with evidence or effectively waived, and the checklist is accepted.
event.readySigning: No blocker: the signing checklist is accepted.
event.closingBlocked: Closing blocked — it cannot be confirmed.
event.signingBlocked: Signing blocked — it cannot be recorded.
event.frozen: This event is {status}: its checklist and conditions are frozen.
event.refusedBlockers: The server refused the command because of these blockers:
event.cpsHint: Each closing has its own CP set. A new CP is not waivable until a specialist determines otherwise.
event.closingsHint: Each has its own CP set and confirmation.

effect.back_to_preparation: The {kind} goes back to preparation; a pending confirmation request is invalidated.

request.title: Request the {kind} confirmation
request.effect: An approval request is created for the authorized confirmation of this {kind}.
request.finalDecision: Link the governance decision of the required type; only its final approval authorizes the confirmation.
request.executedCopy: A signing needs the executed copy of the agreement.

confirm.closingEffect: The closing is confirmed (the transaction closes for this closing).
confirm.signingEffect: The signing is recorded as confirmed; it never closes the transaction.
confirm.reevaluated: The server re-evaluates every blocking CP and checklist item inside this confirmation; any blocker refuses it (and the refusal is logged).
confirm.sod: Not the requester of the confirmation; a final approved decision of the right type is required.
confirm.blockedReason: Not available: the event has open blockers (see Readiness).
confirm.ownRequest: You requested this confirmation: another authorized person must confirm it.
confirm.notYet: Confirmation becomes available when the event is ready and a confirmation has been requested.

checklist.hint: Items belong to exactly one event. Acceptance needs the executed document and a person other than the owner or deliverer.

add.title: Add an item to the {kind} checklist
add.effect: The item belongs to this {kind} only.

deliver.title: Record delivery
deliver.effect: Records the delivery with the executed document version.

accept.title: Accept the delivered item
accept.sod: Not the owner and not the deliverer; the executed document must be usable.

notRequired.title: Mark not required
notRequired.effect: The item is marked not required with a documented reason.

cp.waiverNotEffective: Waived without an effective approved waiver — this does not clear the blocker.
cp.nonWaivableNotice: This condition is NOT waivable (specialist determination): no waiver can be requested or approved, by anyone — including the AI. It remains unmet until it is verified with evidence.
cp.notDeterminedNotice: Not waivable until a specialist determines otherwise: no waiver can be requested now.
cp.waivableNotice: Waivable (specialist determination). A waiver needs a request, then approval by the waiver authority ({role}) — not the requester; the AI cannot create or approve waivers.
cp.evidenceFirst: Link evidence below before submitting the condition for verification.
cp.sodOwner: You own this condition: another authorized person must verify it.
cp.sodSubmitter: You submitted its evidence: another authorized person must verify it.

add.title: Add a condition precedent
add.effect: The CP belongs to this closing only.
add.notWaivable: It is not waivable until a specialist determines otherwise.
add.referenceHint: Upper-case reference; generated when left empty.

submit.title: Submit the condition for verification
submit.effect: The condition waits for verification (linked evidence required).

verify.title: Verify the condition
verify.effect: The condition is verified against its evidence.
verify.effectReject: The evidence is rejected; the condition goes back to open.
verify.sod: Verification by someone other than the owner or the person who submitted the evidence.
verify.human: Human only: the AI cannot verify a condition.

reopen.title: Reopen the condition
reopen.effect: The condition becomes open again (for example defective evidence).

determine.title: Determine blocking status and waivability
determine.effect: Records the specialist determination with its documented basis.

edit.title: Edit the condition
edit.effect: Changes descriptive fields only (never status or waivability).

waivers.title: Waivers
waivers.noneNonWaivable: None — this condition is not waivable.
waivers.requestEffect: The waiver authority ({role}) decides; the condition stays unmet until an approved, unexpired waiver exists.
waivers.aiCannot: The AI can neither create nor approve a waiver.
waivers.approveEffect: The condition is waived by an approved waiver.
waivers.rejectEffect: The waiver is rejected; the condition stays unmet.
waivers.sod: Waiver authority only; not the requester; human only.

funds.title: Funds flow
funds.subtitle: Planned funds-flow lines of a closing, Finance's confirmation and the settlement as reported.
funds.recordOnly: Record-only: the platform tracks the funds flow and never executes, initiates or instructs a payment. There is no payment action here.
funds.open: Open the funds flow of this closing
funds.empty: No funds-flow line recorded for this closing.

fields.amountHint: Leave empty for TBD; an amount needs its currency and unit.
fields.moneyIncomplete: Enter amount, currency and unit together, or leave all three empty (TBD).
fields.settlementHint: The reference of the settlement made OUTSIDE the platform (e.g. by the bank).

create.title: Record a planned funds-flow line
create.effect: A planned line is recorded (amount + currency + unit, or TBD).

confirm.title: Confirm the planned line
confirm.effect: Finance confirms the planned line. Nothing is paid.

report_settled.title: Report a settlement made outside the platform
report_settled.effect: Records that the settlement was reported, with its external reference. The platform does not pay.

obligations.title: Post-close obligations
obligations.subtitle: Conditions subsequent, post-close obligations, appointments, governance, benefits and handover items.
obligations.overdueRule: Overdue is computed in the project timezone once the due date has passed; overdue obligations are escalated automatically. Completion counts only after verification with evidence by another person.
obligations.sodNote: You own or reported this obligation: another person must verify it.
obligations.sodRule: Verification by someone other than the owner or the reporter, with linked evidence.

create.title: Record a post-close obligation
create.effect: The obligation opens with its due date (project timezone).

effect.report_complete: Completion is reported; it waits for verification with evidence.
effect.verify: The completion is verified against the linked evidence.
effect.reject_completion: The completion evidence is rejected; the obligation goes back to in progress.

programClosure.title: Program closure
programClosure.hint: Administrative program closure is separate from transaction closing: it follows its own handover criteria and requires gate G7 (Stabilization & Handover) to pass.
programClosure.requestEffect: A program-closure request is created; another authorized person confirms it (G7 is re-checked).
programClosure.confirmEffect: Confirms or rejects the program closure (not the requester; G7 is re-checked).

external.title: Partner rooms
external.subtitle: The rooms opened to your organisation for this transaction.
external.onlyDisclosed: You see only the items released into your own room and the answers released to your questions. Nothing else is visible from here.
external.noRooms: No room is open to you.
external.noRoomsHint: Access is granted per room, with an expiry, by the authorized team.
external.roomSubtitle: Items released into this room, and your due diligence questions.
external.downloadNotice: Downloads are recorded. Access ends immediately if the grant or a release is withdrawn, or the room is locked.
external.noDisclosures: No item has been released into this room yet.
external.askHint: Your question is filed in this room and answered through the team's review and release process.
external.recorded: Your access to this room is recorded in its access history.
